details: The personnel topic is default-off; the observer is not allocated and the shared formation selector is not read while the topic gate is false.

The named-phase wrapper preserves report insertion, skip predicates, gameplay-body execution, mutation order, ordinary return identity, and exception propagation. A throwing body emits no false phase_end receipt.
All eight scoped direct-writer hooks sit immediately after the existing personnel assignment and record call-local operands/results without reevaluating gameplay predicates.

The generic-probe default-off path is the original filter/sort expression. The enabled path calls each original helper once, in the original short-circuit order, uses the original fitness comparator and brigade-id tie break, and returns the same BrigadeEvaluation identity.

Personnel and commander diagnostics use stableStringify through caught stdout sinks and add no GameState, save, report, weekly, or file-telemetry field. The existing movement_phase report payload is unchanged.
No hardcoded turn, corps, brigade, objective, threshold, or new availability rule was introduced.

blockers.finding: The new generic-probe candidate test covers a finite fitness tie/winner and a rejection at the first disrupted/effective stage only. It does not exercise elite_available, historical_queue_free, or combat_ready as reached failures with later stages left NOT_REACHED; it also does not cover NaN/Infinity/-Infinity tags or assert that the gameplay helpers are called exactly once. Those were explicit 781 acceptance conditions, so source inspection alone cannot close the regression gate.

Presence coverage omits formation_present_undefined and formation_present_null. The real-writer fixture at line 117 executes only regular reinforcement and low-morale desertion, while the sealed claim enumerates bottom_up/enclave reinforcement and collapse desertion as directly covered. It checks source-name presence rather than the branch-local before/after/operand payloads for all eight claimed writer labels.

targeted_correction_required: Add table-driven generic-probe candidates that fail at each successive filter, assert every reached/NOT_REACHED field, finite and nonfinite fitness encoding, sorted ranks/winner, and one-call helper counts without changing production code unless a test exposes a defect.

Add the two missing formation-presence cases and exercise/assert the bottom_up, regular, enclave, WIA, strategic-reserve, frontline-attrition, collapse-desertion, and low-morale-desertion writer payloads at their real assignments.

Run only the affected personnel and commander observer tests in one fresh preserved-preflight directory, followed by the existing seven-file focused set and noEmit only if the correction changes shared fixtures or production source.
